title: FDA Approves First Medication for Obstructive Sleep Apnea
book_use: Chapter 4; The Ozempic Economy; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: Zepbound approval for moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults with obesity; first drug treatment option for that population; two randomized trials totaling 469 adults without type 2 diabetes; Limits: Population- and indication-specific approval; does not establish pharmacotherapy as a universal replacement for PAP or other OSA treatment.
